answer: Each agent must polish a copper mirror: the beacon emits an echo seed each epoch, and the agent must cast a unique reflection. The first casting costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent layer doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at layer 14 (20.4 M iterations). An echo audit verifies each reflection against the epoch seed; any distorted mirror voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full foundry cost because each reflection binds to the unique identity key—no shared polish possible.
